verified_contract.pre_first_active_tolerance: only a 404 V207_ROUTE_DISABLED response carrying a valid UUID distinct from the expected active version
verified_contract.active_route_proof: three consecutive 403 V207_AUTHORITY_REJECTED responses carrying the exact expected active version
verified_contract.post_first_active_policy: every mismatch is terminal after the first exact active match
verified_contract.version_metadata_policy: missing, malformed, or expected-active version on a disabled response is terminal
verified_contract.propagation_bound: 30 reads and 60 seconds with fetch and sleep capped by the remaining deadline
verified_contract.abort_policy: operator abort remains terminal and cleanup uses the independent non-aborted path
verified_contract.later_version_binding: pre-GPU compatibility probe and all later output-port responses remain exact-version-bound
verified_contract.authority_boundary: no provider, image-publication, GPU, fallback, rollback-anchor, retained-volume, or V2-08 authority is activated
